text: raschke: "Far above the average, decelerating, interrupted impulse." Agreed: sma_dist 15.58% is away from value, and I would not buy it at this close (C3, C15). But extension sets my entry location; on its own it is never a reason to oppose (R2). The reclaim on day_vol 2.26 shows demand above structure. My vote is HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS: price back in the zone at structure_shift_ref, then an hourly close above the bar high. If it never comes back, I miss it, at no cost. A daily close under structure_shift_ref-0.5atr fails it.
